linux_prep_fix_body: Kia kotahi te hiahia o to kupuhipa ki te whakarite i tenei rorohiko mo te uira: nga ture USB mo nga taputapu MediaTek me te urunga tauranga rangatū.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Hei whakarite i tenei rorohiko mo te SP Flash Tool, ka hiahiatia to kupuhipa i te taahiraa e whai ake nei ki te whirihora i nga ture USB me te taapiri i to putea ki nga roopu kaiwhakamahi rangatū e hiahiatia ana. Mena ka whakakore koe, ka kati te tono.
linux_prep_needs_access: Kaore i tukuna he urunga, ka hiahiatia e te uira.
linux_prep_fixed: Ka whakaaetia te uru, kua reri te SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Kua oti te tatūnga, kua taapirihia to putea ki nga roopu kaiwhakamahi e hiahiatia ana mo te SP Flash Tool. Me whakaara ano to rorohiko kia mana nga whakaaetanga hou, katahi ka whakatuwhera ano i te taupānga. Pāwhiritia te tohutaki hei kati i te taupānga inaianei.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Kua oti, Katia te Taupānga ki te Tīmata anō i te Rorohiko
settings_driver_desc: I mua i te whakamahi i te taupānga mo te wa tuatahi, me whakauru koe i te taraiwa USB MediaTek, ka whakaara ano i to rorohiko.

settings_guided_install_desc: Ka noho tonu te taupānga ki a koe ma te whakaweto, te hono me te whakauru.
settings_terminal_install: Tāutahia mai i te matapihi kāpeka
settings_sp_gui_install: Tāutahia ki te SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Katia te Updater CE me te whakatuwhera i te SP Flash Tool GUI me te konae whakamararatanga firmware kua tohua me nga whakaahua wehewehe kua utaina.
settings_terminal_desc: Whakahaerehia to whakaurunga rorohiko ki te Terminal kia kite koe i nga korero hangarau mo te ahunga whakamua.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Whakahaerehia to whakaurunga rorohiko ki te Whakatairanga Whakatairanga kia kite koe i nga korero hangarau mo te ahunga whakamua.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Kōwhiringa. Ko etahi o nga whaainga MediaTek e kore e pai ki te uira kia tukuna ra ano he konae motuhēhēnga (.auth) SP Flash Tool; tāpiri mai i a koe ki konei mena ka hiahia te taputapu.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Karekau he konae marara i kitea i roto i tenei kete, na reira kaore e taea te hanga i tetahi tono papatohu.
terminal_install_no_tool: Kaore he hanga SP Flash Tool, he waahi whakauru MTKClient ranei mo tenei tikanga.
terminal_install_failed: Kāore i taea te tūwhera he matapihi kāpeka. I tuhia te tono whakauru ki {path}.
status_terminal_install: Ka whakatuwherahia te tono whakauru ki to matapihi kati ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} ka tuwhera te rere {method}.

• Mena kaore ano kia weto, whakawetohia to {device}.
• Mena kei te hono ki te USB, momotuhia i te tuatahi.
{hint}
• Tūhonohia tō pūrere ki tō rorohiko ina tuwhera te matapihi {terminal_name}.

Patohia te OK hei whakarewa me te puta i te Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Aki: Ki te kore te taputapu e hono aunoa, pehia atahia te patene tautuhi i roto i te kohao me te tope pepa i te wa e hono ana te taura USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Aki: Whakanohoia to taputapu ki te aratau tango firmware (he rereke i te tauira: hei tauira: tango i te pākahiko ka pupuri ki waho me te taura USB e hono ana, whakawetohia ranei me te pākahiko ki roto, pupuri ranei i te Volume Raro/Whakarunga i te wa e hono ana te USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Tāuta mā te SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
Ka tuwhera te SP Flash Tool GUI me to firmware kua utaina.

• I roto i te SP Flash Tool, tohua "Tikiake" mai i te pouaka takaiho.
• Pāwhiritia te pātene "Tikiake".
• Me mohio kua whakawetohia to {device} ka momotuhia.
{hint}
• Tūhono te taura USB ki tō rorohiko i muri i te pāwhiri Tikiake.

Paatohia te OK hei whakarewa i te SP Flash Tool ka puta atu i te Updater CE.
settings_install_themes_desc: Ina whakahohea, ka whakawhiti aunoatia nga kaupapa Rockbox ki Y1 i muri i te whakaurunga a Rockbox angitu.
themes_placement_failed_note: Kaore i taea e matou te whakatakoto i nga kete kaupapa ki runga i to kaitoro. Ka taea e koe te ngana ano mai i nga Tautuhinga.
settings_rockbox_desc: Ka whakamahia i te wa e tirotiro ana i nga tukunga rorohiko.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Whakaatu Pūmanawa Taketake nga putanga tawhito ake i te 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Ko nga putanga Pūmanawa Taketake tawhito ake i te 3.0.7 kaore i te hototahi ki nga wae Y1 i hokona me te Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Ko te whakakorikori i tetahi hanga tawhito ki runga i enei wae ka aukati i a raatau ki te puhipuhi tae noa ki te whakaurunga ano he putanga hou ake.

Kei te tino hiahia koe ki te whakaatu i nga putanga Pūmanawa Taketake tawhito ake i te 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Ka whakaatu i nga hangahanga he momo 240p te konae ROM zip (rom…_240p.zip). Ko nga hangahanga 240p kaore i te hototahi ki nga wae Y1 i runga i te Inniasis OS i raro iho i te 3.0.7, na reira ka taea te whakaatu i nga Waihanga Rockbox Tawhito.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ko nga tukunga o Rockbox-Y1 i mua i te 0.5 kaore i te hototahi ki nga waahanga Y1 i hokona i muri i te Maehe 2026 me te Innioasis OS 3.0.7 i mua i te whakauru.

Ko te whakakorikori i tetahi hanga tawhito ki runga i enei taputapu ka aukati i te puhipuhi.

Kei te tino hiahia koe ki te whakaatu i nga hanga Rockbox tawhito?
sel_back_to_online: ← Hoki ki te Pūmanawa Pūnaha Online
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Tīpakohia koa he .zip, .rar pūranga, he konae marara ranei (*scatter*.txt) ki roto i te kōpaki mārō hei whakauru i tō mārō i kōwhiria ki tō {target}.
sel_offline: Ko nga rarangi ipurangi kaore i te waatea inaianei. Whakamahia he konae paetata, tirohia ranei to hononga.

sel_multiple_scatters_error: I kitea te maha o nga kohinga firmware, nga konae marara ranei i tenei kōpaki/puranga. Tīpakohia he kōpaki, he pūranga rānei kei roto kotahi anake te mōkihi mārō i te wā kotahi.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Neke atu i te kotahi te konae marara kei roto i tenei tukunga, na reira kaore e taea e Updater te whakaatu ko tehea tahora e hiahiatia ana e to kaitoro. Ko te kaiwhakawhanake o {software} me whakahōu i ā rātou putanga mārō ki te whakauru i tētahi kōnae marara noa.

sp_config_missing_storage: Kaore te konae marara e whakaatu he momo rokiroki (EMMC/NAND/UFS), na reira kaore i taea te hanga i te whirihoranga papatohu mo te konae whakamotuhēhēnga; e rarapa ana me te kore.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Karekau he konae motuhēhēnga i hoatu; e rarapa ana karekau he kotahi.
sp_config_write_failed: Kaore i taea te tuhi i te konae whirihoranga papatohu; e rarapa ana me te kore te konae motuhēhēnga.

settings_notifications_warning: Nga panui whakatupato me te haumaru
settings_notifications_background_btn: Whakahohehia nga whakamohiotanga ina katia te taupānga
settings_add_device_type_hint_btn: He aha te momo kei ahau?
settings_add_device_type_hint: Ko te momo ko te whakahoutanga taputapu a te kaitakaro. Ko nga kaitakaro o taua tauira ka taea te hanga i roto i te neke atu i te kotahi te whakahou - hei tauira Momo A me Momo B - ka hangaia he rorohiko mo tetahi o ratou. Tirohia te whakapiri kei muri o te kaitakaro; ki te kore e whakaingoatia he momo, waiho te whiringa tuatahi.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Karekau he putanga mo tenei rorohiko i naianei.

settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Puritia te taupānga ki te pae tahua i muri i te katinga o te matapihi, na reira ka whiwhi tonu koe i nga whakamohiotanga whakamohiotanga o te taupānga me te papamuri. Weto: ka kati te matapihi ka mutu te taupānga.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Puritia te taupānga i roto i te paepae punaha i muri i te katinga o te matapihi, na kei te whiwhi tonu koe i nga whakamohiotanga whakamohiotanga o te taupānga me te papamuri. Weto: ka kati te matapihi ka mutu te taupānga.

sel_themepack_prompt_body: Kua whiti koe i te hanga 360p Rockbox. Kei te pirangi koe ki te whakauru i te Puka Kaupapa 360p ki runga i tenei taputapu inaianei?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Tūhono Pūpāpāho ki te Aratau Rokiroki USB
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Tena koa momotuhia te USB, whakahikohia ka uru ki roto Rockbox kotahi (na reira ka arawhiti i tana kōpaki punaha .rockbox roto), ka hono ano te USB ka kowhiria te 'Aratau Rokiroki USB'.

Ina hono ana, pawhiria te Tonu ki te kowhiri i tetahi kōpaki kei runga i to kaitakaro.

sel_themepack_failed: I rahua te whakaurunga o te Pokai Kaupapa: {err}

sel_only_local_generic: Tīpakohia he mōkihi mārō ā-rohe (.zip, .rar) he kōpaki kei roto he konae marara mo te whakaurunga tuimotu, ka mahi tahi me nga taputapu MediaTek.
sel_offline_install: Tāutahia te mārō mai i te kōnae .zip, .rar rānei i runga i tētahi kaipāho ororongo Innioasis, Timmkoo rānei.
sel_offline_install_generic: Tāutahia te mārō mai i te pūranga .zip/.rar, te kōpaki mārō rānei ki ngā pūrere MediaTek whānui.

conn_online: Kua hoki mai koe ki runga ipurangi.
single_instance_title: Kei te haere kē te kaiwhakahōu
single_instance_body: Kei te tuwhera tetahi atu kape, kei te haere tonu ranei kei muri. E rua nga kape ka whakataetae mo te hononga USB o te kaitakaro, no reira kare tenei e timata.
single_instance_focus_failed: Ko te kape e rere ana kaore i whakautu i te tono kia whakaatu i tana matapihi. Kei te pukumahi, kei te whakairihia ranei. Ko te kaha ki te whakamutu ka haukotia nga mea katoa e whakauru ana.
single_instance_force_failed: Ko te kape e rere ana kaore i taea te whakamutu. Waiho i a koe ano, ka timata ano te whakahou.
single_instance_busy_body: Ko te kape e whakahaere ana kei te whakauru rorohiko, kei te korero ranei ki te kaitakaro, no reira ka mutu i tenei wa ka haukotia tera. Ka kati tenei whakarewanga; whakamahia te matapihi o mua, tona tohu pae tahua ranei ina mutu te whakaurunga.

dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Whakawetohia to taputapu i mua i te tiimata.
• Mēnā ka tio te taputapu, karekau rānei e whakautu, whakamahia he titi, he tope pepa ranei i roto i te kohao tautuhi hei whakakore i te hiko ki te aratau tango.

keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Ka taea noa e matou te pupuri i o tautuhinga i te wa e whakahaere ana te kaitakaro i tenei rorohiko, i tetahi putanga hototahi ranei.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Ka taea anake e matou te pupuri i o tautuhinga me o papapāho i te wa e whakahaere ana te kaitakaro i tenei rorohiko, i tetahi putanga hototahi ranei.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Whakaaetia nga Tautuhinga Pupuri me te Media i runga i tetahi taputapu firmware
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Ka pekehia te patai hototahi. Whakamahia tenei anake ina tino mohio koe ka mahi tonu te kaitakaro me ona tautuhinga me ana papapāho o naianei.
err_keep_data_failed: Kāore i taea te pupuri i ō tautuhinga me ō pāpāho: kāore te kōpaki mārō e taea te tuhi. Kaore he mea i whakauruhia.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Ka pupuri i o tautuhinga me o panui ki runga i te kaitoro. Ko te toenga o te rorohiko kua whakauruhia kia rite ki o mua.
flash_keep_data_warning: Ki te haere tonu koe me te kore e penei, ka tautuhia ano o tautuhinga me o panui ki te rokiroki o roto o te kaitakaro.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Ki te kore koe e haere tonu, ka tangohia o kaupapa Rockbox, momotuhi me o tautuhinga. Ka noho tonu to puoro me etahi atu papapāho ki runga i te kaipāho.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Mena ka haere tonu koe me te kore tenei, ka tangohia o kaupapa Rockbox, momotuhi me nga tautuhinga, ka tautuhi ano te rokiroki o roto o te kaitakaro.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Mena ka haere tonu koe kaore tenei, ka tautuhia ano o tautuhinga. Ka noho tonu to puoro me etahi atu papapāho ki runga i te kaipāho.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Me whakahōputu anō tēnei mārō te rokiroki ā-roto o te kaitākaro. Ka mukua nga tautuhinga kua tiakina; ka noho tonu to puoro me etahi atu korero.
format_all_data_warning_other: Me whakahōputu anō tēnei mārō te rokiroki ā-roto o te kaitākaro. Ka mukua nga tautuhinga kua tiakina me nga papapāho kua rongoa ki runga i te rokiroki kua whakauruhia. Ka noho tonu nga korero kei runga i to microSD.
format_all_confirm_question: Whakahōputuhia te rokiroki o roto i to {model}?
format_all_confirm_body:
Mo te {software} me whakahōputuhia to {model} te rokiroki o roto i mua i to maatau haere. Na ka whakamatauhia tetahi atu taputapu SP Flash Tool, engari i roto i te Whakahōputu Katoa + te aratau Tikiake ma te rere o te aratau papatohu XML.

support_story_1_headline: Ka neke nga kaihanga, ka piki ake te hapori.
support_story_1_lead: Te tiaki i to taputapu mai i nga mahanga taputapu wahangu me nga whakahou pakaru.
support_story_1_body: I nga wa katoa ka whakaputahia e Innioasis nga miihini hou mo nga kaitakaro penei i te Y1 (e whai ana i nga whakahoutanga o te poari huna penei i te 6.0, 7.0, me te 8.0) ka pakaru puku i nga taputapu tawhito. Ko te mea kino ake, ko ta raatau paetukutuku e whakarato ana i nga whakatupato kore me te kore uru ki nga umanga mahi o mua ki te whakaora mai i te ahua pereki. Ko te Updater CE me te kaupapa Community Firmware te tiki i nga waahanga: ka whakarangatira matou i nga ROM taonga tuku iho katoa, ka manatoko aunoa i to arotakenga taputapu, ka noho humarie to kaitoro.
support_story_1_item_1: Te Whakaoranga i nga Kaitakaro Whati: Ko nga arowhai haumaru ka whakarite i nga whakahoutanga hou kaore he pereki taputapu tawhito.
support_story_1_item_2: Nga ROM Stock kua whakapumautia: Kua oti te kohinga o nga miihini wheketere taketake kua mukua a Innioasis.
support_story_1_item_3: Kaupapa Whakawhiti Maori: Nga taputapu uira katoa mo te macOS, Linux, me te Matapihi.
support_story_1_item_4: Maramatanga Pūmārō: Te kimi papa aunoa kia whiwhi koe i te kete tika.
support_story_2_headline: Kaore he Google Drive kua pakaru. Karekau he mahi matapae. Te mahi noa i te firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Te tere tere, nga hanganga hapori kua whakamanahia ka taea e koe te whakawhirinaki.
support_story_2_body: Ko te whai i nga raupaparorohiko whaimana a Inniiasis te tikanga ko te whiu i nga huihuinga mo nga hononga a Google Drive kua pau, nga hea kapua Baidu kua mate, me nga konae konae konae ngaro kaore he taputapu uira. I hangaia e matou he whatunga tango pono, motuhake me te pono SHA-256 manatoko, whakamohiotanga whakamohiotanga, me nga whakaurunga arataki-a-taahiraa. Ko o koha e pupuri tika ana i nga tango me te manaaki e taea ai tenei 24 haora ia ra, 365 ra ia tau.
support_story_2_item_1: Tikanga CDN Tere-Teitei: He tere, he tango tika kaore he rohe tango, he hononga mate ranei.
support_story_2_item_2: Whakamōhiotanga Whakahōu: Kia mataara i te wa ka tukuna mai e te hapori hou, ka taka ranei nga whakatika.
support_story_2_item_3: Ko nga Whakataunga Maataki-a-Taahiraa: Maamaa nga tohu whakakitenga e haere ana koe i ia pehi paatene.
support_story_2_item_4: Hapori reo-maha: Kua oti te waahi ki te reo Ingarihi, Hainamana, Tiamana, Paniora, Wīwī me Hapanihi.
support_story_3_headline: Te wetewete i te kaha katoa o to kaitakaro Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Te kawe mai i te Rockbox, nga punaha whakahaere ngawari, me te waatea o te hunga whakarongo.
support_story_3_body: Ko te rorohiko wheketere kararehe ka rakuraku noa i te mata o nga mea ka taea e to taputapu Y1, Y2 ranei. I kawea mai e to matou hapori te Rockbox, nga punaha whakahaere ngawari, te purei kotēke audiophile, me nga kaupapa ritenga ki te ora. Ka hokona e matou nga rereketanga o nga taputapu tinana i waho o te pute hei whakamatautau, whakamuri i te miihini, me te manatoko i ia whakaurunga. Ko te tautoko i te Updater CE ka utu tika i enei waahanga whakamatautau me te whakatere i te whakawhanaketanga firmware ritenga.
support_story_3_item_1: Pouaka Pouaka-Kotahi: Ko te purei ororongo me nga kaupapa ritenga kua whakauruhia ki roto i nga hēkona.
support_story_3_item_2: Maamaa Hapori: Whakapaihia te pākahiko, UI horoi, me te tautoko kotēkē ororongo hou.
support_story_3_item_3: Te Taiwhanga Taonga Hohe: Ka whakamatauhia e matou nga taputapu tinana tuuturu i mua i te tuku i tetahi hanga.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% kore utu, pūmanawa tūmataiti-tuatahi karekau he pānuitanga, he aroturuki.
support_story_4_headline: Awhinatia matou ki te mahi i nga mea kaore e mahia e Inniiasis.
support_story_4_lead: Ko te whakamarumaru umanga a-hapori e pupuri ana i o taputapu ki waho o nga putunga whenua.
support_story_4_body: Ina neke atu tetahi kamupene taputapu ki o raatau taputapu ka whai ake, ka whakarerea nga tauira tawhito. Karekau he tautoko Linux a Innioasis, karekau he raarangi huringa marama, kaore he huarahi ngawari ki te whakaora ina rahua te whakaurunga. Kei te noho a Updater CE na te mea kaore nga kaiwhakamahi ngakau nui ki te maka atu i tetahi kaiwhakatangi puoro tino pai. 100% o nga takoha a te hapori ka haere tika ki te pupuri i tenei taputapu kia tuwhera mo te katoa.
support_story_4_item_1: Whakaoranga me te Unbrick: Ka rere te whakaoranga ahakoa kaore nga taputapu e pai ki te whawhai.
support_story_4_item_2: Tautoko Tuatahi-Class Linux: Ka tautokona katoatia a MediaTek e whiti ana i runga i nga distros Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Nga Huringa Puataata: Nga korero tuku taipitopito kia mohio koe he aha nga huringa.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Ka utua e te Hapori: Ko ia kawhe ka noho tuwhera te purongo me te kore utu mo te katoa.
support_methods_subtitle: Kōwhirihia to tikanga takoha e pai ana koe. Ko ia koha ka utu tika i nga tangohanga, te manaaki, me nga taputapu whakamatautau.

err_mtk_output_stall_title: Te ahua o te uira kua mau tonu
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Kua whakaatuhia e te taputapu uira te rarangi kotahi mo te {seconds} hēkona whakamutunga, me te ahua kaore e mau tonu ana te tuhi i te firmware. I rahua pea te uira. Mena koinei te whakamutunga o nga nganatanga e rua me ia tikanga i runga i te punaha ka hoki whakamuri i waenga i a raatau, mena kei te waatea noa te MTKClient ki tenei miihini, whakaara ano i te rorohiko ka ngana ano.

err_only_mtkclient_desc: Ko MTKClient anake e waatea ana mo tenei whakaurunga. I rahua pea te uira. Me whakaara ano te rorohiko ka ngana ano.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Ka taea hoki e tenei rorohiko te whakauru ma te whakamahi i te SP Flash Tool. Ki te taea, huri ki SP Flash Tool ka ngana ano.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: I rahua pea te uira. Tena panuihia te karere i runga ake nei ka whakaara ano i te rorohiko i mua i te ngana ano. Mena ka paatohia e koe te OK, ka mutu te taupānga kia taea ai e koe te whakaara ano.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Kei te ngaro te konae titaritari, nga konae atahanga e hiahiatia ana ranei i te kete firmware. Tena koa tango ano i te kete, kowhiria ranei he konae firmware.
err_auth_file_unusable_title: Kōnae Motuhēhēnga Kore e taea te whakamahi
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Kei te ngaro te konae motuhēhēnga i kōwhiria e koe, kei te noho kau, karekau rānei e taea te tuhi. Kōwhiria he kōnae whaimana, ūkuia rānei i roto i ngā Tautuhinga, kātahi ka whiti ano.
err_tool_unavailable_title: Ko te Utauta Utauta Kore i Wātea
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ko te taputapu uira me nga taraiwa punaha e hiahiatia ana kaore i taea te arawhiti. Tena koa tirohia nga whakaaetanga punaha, tatūnga atekōkiri, tāuta anō rānei i te taupānga.
err_driver_missing_title: E hiahiatia ana te Atekōkiri USB MediaTek
err_driver_missing_desc: Ka puta tenei hapa i te mea kaore i whakauruhia te taraiwa USB MediaTek. Pāwhiritia Tikiake Atekōkiri hei tāuta i te atekōkiri USB MediaTek, tīmata anō i tō rorohiko, ka ngana anō.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Kei te ngaro tetahi konae firmware keteroki. Kōwhiria te Pūmanawa Tīpakohia hei hanga anō i ngā kōnae kua tangohia, hei tango anō rānei i te pūranga mārō. He raruraru kōnae rohe tenei, ehara i te take hononga USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Hoki ki te Tohu Pūmanawa ki te hanga anō, ki te tango rānei i te mōkihi mārō.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Tīpakohia he tuku mārō hei tiki anō.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: I puta he hapa ohorere i te wa o te whakaurunga ({detail}). Whakaweto rawatia te kaitākaro, hono anō ina ākina, ka ngana anō.
flash_attempt_timeout: E tatari ana mo te kaitakaro… {seconds} kei te toe
flash_method_confirm: I hurihia te aratuka tāuta ki {method}. Whakaaetia kua wetekina te kaitoro ka wetohia, ka paato i te Panuku.
flash_failover_note: {method} kaore i timata te whakaurunga. I muri i te whakaweto o te kaitoro me te wetewete i te mono, ka whakamahia te {other}.
themepack_card_desc: Kei roto ko nga kaupapa hapori ataahua, nga papamuri taumira teitei, me nga momotuhi i hangaia mo nga whakaaturanga 360p.
themepack_installed_success: 360p Kaupapa Kaupapa i oti pai te whakauru!
themepack_step1_title: Hipanga 1: Hono i roto i te Aratau Rokiroki USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Whakakāhia tō kaitākaro mā te pupuri i te pātene Power.
2. A, no te putu Rockbox, mono te taura USB ki tō rorohiko.
3. Ki te ue'i i runga i te mata kaitākaro, whakaūhia te aratau Rokiroki USB kia puta te pūrere hei puku.
themepack_step2_title: Hipanga 2: Tīpakohia Tetahi Kōpaki i runga i te Pūpāpāho
themepack_step2_desc: Na te mea ka huna e nga punaha whakahaere (penei i te macOS) nga konae ira (penei i te .rockbox) ma te taunoa, ka taea e koe te kowhiri i TĒTAHI kōpaki, te puku puku ranei i runga i to kaitakaro. Ka kimi aunoa, ka waihangahia ranei e matou te raarangi .rockbox mo koe.
themepack_status_downloading: Tikiake ana i te 360p Kaupapa Kaupapa...
themepack_complete: I pai te whakauru o te kete kaupapa! Ka taea e koe te momotu marie i to kaitakaro ka kowhiri i tetahi kaupapa i roto i te Rockbox (Tautuhinga> Tautuhinga Kaupapa).
themepack_err_not_found: Kāore i taea te kimi, te arawhiti rānei i tētahi whaiaronga .rockbox i te puku i tīpakohia. Me whakarite kua tohua e koe he kōpaki i runga i to kaitakaro.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Haere ki te Aratau Rokiroki USB
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Hipanga 1: Tīmatahia te kaitākaro me te hono ano
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Momotuhia te taura USB.
2. Whakahokia ano te kaitoro ka tuku ki roto i te Rockbox.
3. Kia rere a Rockbox, hono ano te taura USB, ka pehi i te Haere tonu.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Hipanga 2: Te rapu mo te kaitoro mo ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Kei te titiro te taupānga mo te hononga ADB (tae atu ki te 30 hēkona). Mena ka kitea he taputapu, ka whakawhitia nga kaupapa, ka whakaara ano te kaitakaro. Ki te kore, peke whakamua ki te Aratau Rokiroki USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: E tatari ana mo tetahi taputapu ADB... (tae atu ki te 30 hēkona)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: I kitea te taputapu ({serial}); whakawhiti kaupapa...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Kaore he taputapu ADB i kitea i roto i te 30 hēkona; kei te haere tonu me te Aratau Rokiroki USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Kaore he putea ADB e waatea ana ki te taupānga; kei te haere tonu me te Aratau Rokiroki USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: E pana ana nga kaupapa me nga momotuhi ki runga i te ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: I rahua te whakawhiti ADB; ka hoki ki te Aratau Rokiroki USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Tāuta mā te Aratau Rokiroki USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Whakahohehia te Aratau Rokiroki USB i runga i te kaitakaro kia puta he puku.
2. Tīpakohia TĒTAHI kōpaki i runga i te kaitākaro i raro nei (.rockbox, Waiata, Kaupapa, te puku puku ranei, he kōpaki .rockbox huna kei te noho aunoa).
3. Ka hanumi te taupānga i nga kaupapa 360p me nga momotuhi ki roto, ka tuhirua i nga konae ingoa kotahi.
rockbox_wizard_done_title: 360p kaupapa me nga momotuhi kua whakauruhia!
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Ka taea e koe te momotu marie i te kaitakaro ka kowhiri i tetahi kaupapa i roto i te Rockbox (Tautuhinga> Tautuhinga Kaupapa).
rockbox_stage_installing: Kei te Tāuta Kaupapa Rockbox & Momotuhi...
rockbox_cleanup_step: Te tango i nga tautuhinga Rockbox tawhito...
rockbox_cleanup_deleting: Te tango i te kōpaki .rockbox mai i te kaitākaro...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: I whakauruhia to rorohiko hou, engari kaore i taea te tango i te kōpaki .rockbox tawhito. Mukua te kōpaki .rockbox i runga i te kaitākaro mā te ringa ki te hiahia koe i te timatanga ma.
rockbox_stage_waiting_adb_fmt: Kei te rapu kaitakaro ma te ADB ({remaining}s)...
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Neke atu i te kotahi te kaitakaro e hono ana. Momotuhia etahi atu ka waiho ko te mea anake e whakauruhia ana.
rockbox_stage_pushing: I kitea te kaitakaro. Te whakatakoto kaupapa hapori me nga momotuhi...
rockbox_stage_pushing_files_fmt: Te whakatakoto i nga konae kaupapa ({curr} o {total})...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Purihia te patene pokapū ki te hiko ki to Y1, hono ano i te USB, ka kowhiria te Aratau Rokiroki USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Purihia te paatene mana ki te hiko i runga i to kaitakaro, hono ano i te USB, ka kowhiria te Aratau Rokiroki USB.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Kaore e timata te taputapu? Whakaora i te pūmanawa taketake
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Tena koa momotuhia me te whakakaha i to {model}, ka pehi i te Panuku
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Momotuhia te USB, purihia te {button} ki te hiko i to {model}, ka pehi i te Panuku.
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Whakahohea koa te aratau rokiroki USB ki to taputapu ka paato Panuku
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Whakahohea koa te aratau rokiroki USB i runga i to {model}, ka whiriwhiri i te puku ka puta
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Tīpakohia koa te kaitākaro ake, tetahi ranei o nga kōpaki kei runga
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Momotuhia te USB me te hiko ki to Y1, ka pehi i te Panuku.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Momotuhia te USB me te hiko ki runga i to {model}, ka pehi i te Panuku.
rockbox_ask_running_fmt: Kei te rere a Rockbox i runga i to {model}?
rockbox_running_yes: Ae, kei te rere a Rockbox
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Tīpakohia 'Aratau Rokiroki USB' i runga i to kaitakaro.
2. Pāwhiritia 'Tirotiro Kōpaki...' ki te tīpako i tō kaitākaro me te tāuta kaupapa.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Ko tenei hanga Rockbox e whakamahi ana i nga kaupapa 240x320, kaore i te paihere. Tikina nga kaupapa kore utu mo to kaitakaro mai i te pae kaupapa Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Ki te kore to {model} e puhipuhi, momotuhia te USB, purihia te paatene hiko mo te 10s ki te tautuhi, ka whakakaha. Whakahokia ranei te rorohiko taketake.
err_storage_full_title: He iti rawa te mokowā kōpae
err_storage_full_desc: Kua pau te waahi rokiroki o to rorohiko. Whakawātea koa te mokowā kōpae ki tō puku ka ngana anō.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Kei runga tonu i tenei rorohiko tetahi putanga tawhito o Updater me te tango mokowā kōpae. Ma te wetewete ka whakawātea taua wāhi.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Ka whakahoki ano i te {size} o te mokowā kōpae
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Tangohia te tono Innioasis Updater tawhito me nga kōpaki tautoko
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Kia mau ki te whakauru i nga Utauta Raarangi Android (ADB / Fastboot).
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Mena kaore koe e whakamahi i te ADB, i te Fastboot ranei i waho o te Updater CE, wetekina ki te tango me te whakahoki mai i etahi atu rokiroki.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: I momoho te horoi i te whakaurunga tuku iho me te mokowā kōpae i tangohia.
donate_completion_subtitle_the_software: Kua whakauruhia te rorohiko ki to {model}.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: He putanga tawhito o Updater kei runga tonu i tenei rorohiko. Ma te wetewete ka whakawāteahia te mokowā kōpae.
legacy_cleanup_none_found: Karekau he putanga tawhito i kitea.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Ka whakakorea katoatia te taupānga tawhito, te firmware kua tikiakehia, me nga toenga o nga konae.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Tangohia nga Utauta Raarangi Android (ADB / Fastboot) ano hoki? Whiriwhiria te Pupuri mena ka whakamahi koe i te ADB.
legacy_cleanup_done_inline: Kua tangohia, tata ki te {size} kua wetekina.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Whakakitea te konae rangitaki i roto i te Finder / Explorer
log_btn_save_file_tip: Kaweake i te kōnae rangitaki kua whakaaturia ki te kōpae
log_btn_copy_tip: Tāruatia te rangitaki kua whakaaturia ki te papatopenga

settings_arm64_driver_note: Ko te tautoko Windows ARM64 kaore i whakamatauria. I runga i nga pona rorohiko Snapdragon me RTX Spark, ka taea te whakamahi a Zadig me te Whakaaetanga Waitohu Atekōkiri kua monokia ki te whakauru WinUSB, libusb ranei mo te taputapu MT6227 Preloader ki te Kaiwhakahaere Pūrere. Tirohia te aratohu taraiwa ARM64 mo nga taahiraa.
toast_update_fmt: Kei te waatea te whakahou ki te {app}.
keep_data_which_firmware_fmt: Ko tehea rorohiko kei te whakahaere i to {model}?
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
